BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.

2. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.

3. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
